profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: West Palm Beach, Florida, United States
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience designing scalable distributed systems. Specialized in Java, microservices, and event-driven architectures. Recently focused on enabling enterprise systems for AI interoperability through Model Context Protocol (MCP) and LLM-integrated service architectures.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Senior Software Engineer on the Intelligence team at Instinct Science, building AI-powered search and assistant features for the leading veterinary EMR — Elixir/Phoenix, React/TypeScript, full-text/vector search, and LLM integrations.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained scalable microservices using Java and Spring Boot, aligned with domain-driven design principles.
• Implemented CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation) patterns to separate read and write workloads, improving performance and maintainability.
• Designed and consumed RESTful and GraphQL APIs to integrate internal and external healthcare services.
• Built robust event-driven systems using Apache Kafka for asynchronous communication and decoupled service orchestration.
• Wrote comprehensive unit and integration tests using JUnit, contributing to high code quality and continuous integration workflows.
• Designed and optimized MySQL and MongoDB schemas to support both transactional and NoSQL data needs in a multi-tenant environment.
• Designed AI-enablement architecture allowing LLMs to securely consume domain services via MCP tooling.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Boot · GraphQL · MongoDB · MySQL · Apache Kafka · CQRS · GitHub · React.js · HTML · CSS · LLM · Model Context Protocol (MCP)

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
I am a Software Architect at GEOCOM Uruguay, where I define architecture specifications for new products and support the team as a Senior Developer. My role involves ensuring the successful development and implementation of innovative solutions for our clients.

- Microservices-based architecture and development of integration with mobile recharge services and digital wallets, consuming APIs such as Claro, Antel, and TuApp for Tata’s solution.
- Architected 15+ microservices solutions for mobile recharge services, bill payments, and gift cards, integrating APIs for MTCenter, Immex, and RedEfectiva for YZA Pharmacies' solution.
- Architected 10+ microservices solutions for mobile recharge and bill payment services, integrating APIs from Disashop, Moviired, InComm, and PuntoRed for OXXO International's solution.
- Reduced deployment times by 80% by implementing CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, Docker, and Kubernetes.
- Refactored the Conciliator product, adding integrations with 5+ payment methods and achieving 95% test coverage via unit/integration tests.
- Designed and developed Bepsa’s Integrator product using Spring WebFlux, delivering a REST API for POS, administration, and cash management.
- Refactoring the integration with Mercado Pago for QR payments, involving migration from Spring Boot 2.7.1 to Spring Boot 3.4.1, as well as code improvements and cleanup, supporting the changes with integration tests.
- Architecture and development of the QR payment integration consuming the Transbank API, MachPay's API and Banco Estado's API in Chile.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
In my role as a Senior Full Stack Developer at GEOCOM Uruguay S.A., I led the design and implementation of system architecture for the ecommerce team. I developed custom applications using Java in the backend and Angular in the frontend, utilizing a wide range of technologies such as Spring Boot, Angular and Docker.

- Led a team of 5 developers in the development of Geopos Express, a multi-tenant microservices platform for Point of Sale (POS) systems. This centralized end-to-end business operations, resulting in a 20% reduction in operational costs for clients.
- Led GeoStation fuel management system, integrating DUCSA controllers for two gas stations.
- Built Angular-based frontend for Tienda Inglesa’s self-checkout system, reducing customer wait times by 15%.
- I was part of the implementation of a teleconsultation system developed during the COVID pandemic, which was integrated into GeoSalud and used by CASMU.
- Architected Farmashop (Magento E-commerce) for Uruguay’s largest pharmacy group, increasing online sales by 60% through loyalty and logistics modules.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: In my role as a Software Developer at ADWEB Solutions in Havana, Cuba, I was responsible for creating systems in PHP and Java using various tools such as Joomla, Magento, Wordpress, Laravel, Symfony, and Spring Framework. I collaborated with teams to deliver high-quality solutions, optimized coding practices for improved performance, and ensured a seamless user experience.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · AngularJS · PHP · Object Oriented Design · Java Development · PL/SQL

positions.description: I worked as a Software Developer at Universidad de las Ciencias Informáticas in Havana, Cuba. I collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure successful project delivery and implementation. I implemented innovative solutions to enhance user experience and functionality, resulting in increased efficiency and user satisfaction.

projects.title: CheckMate - AI-Powered PR Review Platform
projects.description:
A modern web application that streamlines pull request reviews across multiple GitHub instances with integrated LLM assistance.

Key Features:
• Multi-instance GitHub integration with OAuth and PAT authentication
• Advanced PR search and filtering using GitHub's Search API
• AI-powered review assistant with OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoints (GPT-4, Claude-3, Gemini)
• Persistent chat history and context switching between models
• Modern three-pane responsive interface built with Vue 3 + Tailwind CSS
• Real-time MCP (Model Context Protocol) process monitoring

Technical Stack:
• Backend: Node.js, Express, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL
• Frontend: Vue 3, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Pinia
• Deployment: Docker, docker-compose
• Authentication: Okta/Auth0 integration
• APIs: GitHub REST API, OpenAI-compatible endpoints
